item.title: Shared drive connectors for Lumen Assistant enter public preview
item.description: Lumen Assistant can now search Orbit Drive shared drives, in public preview for Team and Enterprise workspaces. Connector access follows each user's existing file permissions.

item.title: Higher usage limits on the Lumen Team plan
item.description: Team plan members get higher daily usage limits starting today. Limits reset every 5 hours.

item.title: Admin audit log export for Lumen Enterprise
item.description: Enterprise admins can now export 180 days of audit logs as CSV or send them to a SIEM over HTTPS. Generally available today.
